professionalSummary.text: Takes cohorts of branches from survey to reopening on an agreed refit schedule.
professionalSummary.witness: Refit project manager at a high-street bank from 2022 to 2025, taking four cohorts of twelve branches each from survey to reopening on schedules agreed with the property team and the fit-out contractor.

experienceHighlights.text: Tracks each branch's cost against the cohort budget and reports to the refit steering group.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tracked every branch's cost against the cohort budget in the programme cost tool and reported fortnightly to the refit steering group; the forty-eight branches closed within budget at cohort level.

projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Resolved the clashes between the fit-out and the branches' IT and cash-handling changes through the programme's clash log, with the IT and cash-handling teams' sign-off recorded against each clash.

skills.text: Prepares reopening readiness for each branch, with the reopening decision staying with the regional director, and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Prepared the reopening readiness pack for each branch; the reopening decision was the regional director's, recorded on the pack together with the checks that were mine and the checks that were branch operations'.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience and evidence are sufficient to warrant qualified human review, but no hiring decision has been made.

evidence.text: Refit project manager at a high-street bank from 2022 to 2025, taking four cohorts of twelve branches each from survey to reopening on schedules agreed with the property team and the fit-out contractor.
Tracked every branch's cost against the cohort budget in the programme cost tool and reported fortnightly to the refit steering group; the forty-eight branches closed within budget at cohort level.
Resolved the clashes between the fit-out and the branches' IT and cash-handling changes through the programme's clash log, with the IT and cash-handling teams' sign on recorded against each clash.

Prepared the reopening readiness pack for each branch; the reopening decision was the regional director's, recorded on the pack together with the checks that were mine and the checks that were branch operations'.
Closed each branch refit with the snagging list agreed with the contractor and the reopening certificate countersigned by the branch manager.
evidence.notes: The candidate closed each branch refit with the snagging list and the reopening certificate, but the materials do not explicitly state that the reopening certificate was countersigned by the branch manager.

missingEvidence: The reopening certificate was countersigned by the branch manager.
